title: A/P Detail: a date after today ages a bill to that day
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Create, for this test, a vendor with one unpaid bill, bill A, whose due date is today.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only that vendor ticked in the Vendor filter, so bill A is the only bill listed.
custom_steps:
1. Expand the "Current" bucket.
  2. Click the date chip ("As of: " and today's date).
  3. Pick the day 10 days after today in the calendar.
  4. Expand the "1-30 days past due" bucket.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bill A is listed in "Current", with Past Due 0: it is due today.

Step 2:

  • A calendar opens with today's date selected.
  • Days after today can be picked.

Step 3:

  • The chip reads "As of: " and the day 10 days after today.
  • The report reloads for that day.

Step 4:

  • Bill A is listed here, with Past Due 10: the days from its due date to the picked day.
  • Bill A is no longer in "Current".

Where the tech plan differs: the tech plan (21 Oct 2026, decision D20) caps the as-of date at today; PRD version 13 (13 Nov 2026) lets any day be picked, including a day after today, as before this release. This case follows the PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026, version re-checked 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R10b: “The as-of date can be any day, including a day after today, as today. For a day after today the report counts everything entered so far and counts days past due to the picked day; the chip, the PDF and the CSV all show the picked day. A link with an as-of date opens on that date.”
  • S1-R5a: “A document is Current when its due date is on or after the as-of date. Its Past Due, where the report shows one, is the number of days from the due date to the as-of date: negative while the document is not yet due (a bill due 9 days after the as-of date reads -9, as today) and 0 on its due date. A credit memo, deposit or vendor credit counts its own date as its due date, so one dated exactly on the as-of date is in Current with Past Due 0, not in "1-30 days past due". This is how QuickBooks ages them (SV-11441).”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D20: “The native date chip already caps at today (maxDate); label and data always agree.”

Not yet checked against a build in this form: rewritten 14 Nov 2026 for PRD version 13 (it checked that a day after today could not be picked); that earlier form was last checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html).
